Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
Card text Vidal:

Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., Black Hand) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.

When Vidal meets the requirements of a card requiring a Prince, does he choose a specific city for that? If so, can he use cards requiring a Prince multiple times, choosing different cities every time?

In principle, my question is if the following ruling for Vlad Tepes holds for Vidal as well:

When meeting a requirement, the controller can choose how he meets it (eg. he can play {Anarch Secession} as a Prince of any city, even a made-up one). [PIB 20150306](www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/69627-vlad-tepes-regent?start=12#69696) [PIB 20150307](www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/69627-vlad-tepes-regent?start=18#69732)

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Yomyael wrote:
> Card text Vidal:
>
> Camarilla: Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., Black Hand) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.
>
> When Vidal meets the requirements of a card requiring a Prince, does he choose a specific city for that?
>
Yes, but it only matters if it is relevant (Anarch Secession).

> Yomyael wrote:
> If so, can he use cards requiring a Prince multiple times, choosing different cities every time?
>
No, because all the card that require a generic Prince have the same requirement (which can only be met once, per cardtext).

> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> Followup question:
>
> Does Vidal have to specify a specific Sababt title to play under siege, or can he use the the generic "titles"-trait and the sect?
>
An existing Sabbat title: once as bishop, once as archbishop, once as cardinal, and once as regent.

> Hobbesgoblin wrote:

He must choose a title.

groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/d_hgYPrdBkw/m/VqyIutR_2pcJ

> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> Or is (titles) not a trait, and just a reminder-text?
>
Reminder text.

> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> Or are "has x votes (title)" it it's enterety the tiele, and can be therefore used fby vidal?
>
"X votes" is a title, and Vidal can emulate it only once: he cannot emulate "2 votes" if he has already emulated "1 vote".

Messages.Author: KoRneeshon
Messages.Body:
"Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., Black Hand) [...] "

Why are the titles even discussed here? Are they "traits" by mean of Vidal text?
I always thought that traits are things like Black Hand, Seraph, Infernal, Flight, Slave, Sterile, Red List, Scarce - but *NOT* sects or titles.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> KoRneeshon wrote:
> "Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., Black Hand) [...] "
>
> Why are the titles even discussed here? Are they "traits" by mean of Vidal text?
>
They are.

> KoRneeshon wrote:
> I always thought that traits are things like Black Hand, Seraph, Infernal, Flight, Slave, Sterile, Red List, Scarce
>
Those are traits too.

> LSJ wrote:
> Traits are basically the bold terms found at the top of card text to give it
> some kind of label. Clan and uniqueness are also traits."
>
> But for the record:
>
> A trait is a term used in card text (usually in bold at the top, not within the
> prose) to give it some kind of label. It may have some rulebook-defined meaning
> or effect, like "blood cursed" or "sterile", or it may not be defined by the
> rules, like "ammo" or "seraph". It doesn't include capacity (a number) or
> Disciplines, but does include clan, sect, title, advanced, circle, flight, and
> so on. Basically anything that Seeds of Corruption doesn't count.
>
> It also includes unique, even though vampires omit that trait from their texts
> (since they are unique by default).
>
> Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g. anarch)
> requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each
> game. +1 bleed.
>
> As far as Vidal is concerned, "non-<trait>" is also a trait (including other
> forms like "untitled" or "with no title").
>
> For Vidal in particular, note that the following are not traits (listed here for
> Googling; these should be obvious from the above and/or from innate obviousness):
>
> (un)tapped
> (not) ready
> younger/older
> above/below certain capacity
> contested
> empty
> with some amount/range of blood
> with some card (like Aye, Kerrie, or True Faith)
> same clan/sect/age/circle
> can(not) commit diablerie
> has(n't) commited diaberlie
> (non-)acting
> attempting to block
> is bleeding/hunting
> bled/hunted/acted/blocked (un)successfully
> moved to the ready region since your last turn
> controlled by another/the same Methuselah
>
> And he cannot meet non-vampire traits (like "Mortal" or "Ghoul" or "Ammo" or creed).
>
> Also for Googling, here's a list of some of the more FAQ-inducing traits that
> Vidal can meet (not exhaustive):
>
> Baron
> Liaison
> Caitiff
> Inquisitor
> Seraph
> non-Camarilla
> non-Red List
>
